WITH a AS (
  SELECT date,
         COUNT(*) AS attempts,
         AVG(CASE WHEN succeeded THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS success_rate,
         AVG(CASE WHEN issue_roll THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS rollout_share
  FROM cpe_update_attempt
  GROUP BY 1
), i AS (
  SELECT ua.date,
         COUNT(*) AS issues
  FROM cpe_issue ci
  JOIN cpe_update_attempt ua ON ci.update_attempt_id = ua.id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT a.date,
       attempts,
       ROUND(success_rate*100,1) AS success_pct,
       COALESCE(issues,0) AS issues,
       ROUND(COALESCE(issues,0)*100.0/attempts,2) AS issues_per_100,
       ROUND(rollout_share*100,1) AS rollout_pct
FROM a
LEFT JOIN i USING (date)
ORDER BY date
